flags.why: Tiền chẵn has no fixed 20,000-dong threshold, and smaller denominations can qualify ([example](https://www.toaan.gov.vn/webcenter/ShowProperty?nodeId=%2FUCMServer%2FTAND096770)).
flags.fix: large-denomination notes, as opposed to small change (relative to the transaction)

flags.why: The tune or melody sense is not restricted to traditional folk dances ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-lao/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-xoang)).
The musical sense is literary and old-fashioned, which the rare tag alone does not convey ([dictionary](https://loigiaihay.com/tu-dien-tv/xoang-ewoEDE3xES3IZ.html)).
